rationale: The plan matches the reference: EPIC (melanoma-appropriate tumour reference, stated) and quanTIseq (tumour mode) on unfiltered linear TPM, MCP-counter on log2(TPM+1) with scores explicitly not treated as fractions or compared across populations, no CIBERSORT portal, and one Wilcoxon/limma test per cell type with BH across cell types within method, effect sizes and group summaries beside adjusted p-values. QC is thorough (PCA, distances, detected genes, signature-gene coverage, explicit retention policy for sample_01), the 1 TPM/6-sample filter is restricted to the scoring track and justified, and no count normalization touches the TPM. Minor gaps: the limma-vs-Wilcoxon choice is left to runtime with no reference level stated, no explicit alpha is given, and running five methods plus UCell with a two-method consensus rule adds machinery beyond what the question needs, though nothing incorrect. The report section names versions, references, stacked bars, and the reference-dependence and design caveats.
